scope: Standalone Apple Music download integration; private Telegram deployment excluded

files.change: Retry invalid responses from the local playlist service

notes: Only explicitly selected integration modules were copied.
Credentials, cookie contents, account sessions, deployment URLs, databases, logs, media, and Telegram configuration are excluded.
Catalog pagination, fragment retry/completeness checks and duration validation are included.
The private Telegram application, channel publishing, album cards and Telegram music ZIP workflow are not part of this CLI.
Third-party packages and service binaries are installed separately; no installed package or private dependency wheel is bundled.
